field.label: Enabled
field.help: Disable to keep this listener's configuration without starting it.

field.label: Description
field.help: Optional label shown in the listener list and used as the policy name in the generated config.

field.label: Interface
field.help: Listeners must bind to one specific interface/VLAN -- "all interfaces"/0.0.0.0 is never offered here. "Loopback (127.0.0.1 / ::1)" is a special option for routing the firewall's own DNS through ctrld too, not a real interface.

field.label: IP version
field.help: Which address family to bind on the interface selected above. Most setups only need IPv4; add a second listener with the same interface and IPv6 selected if you also want to serve DNS over that interface's IPv6 address. Unverified against a live IPv6 setup -- see the reference doc's Known limitations.

field.label: Port
field.help: Typically 53. Must not collide with a port Unbound or Dnsmasq already binds on this interface.
